scope: Unified fictional local system preview. Catalog coverage plus explicit behavior tests. Not backend, real-model, real-email, security, concurrency, or physical-phone acceptance.

initial preview allows recording without AI while free entertainment is locked
saving original unlocks daily allowance without settling an event
first record sign-in grants the agreed three coins once
event analyzes without manual tier or relevance fields
event provides a cancellable queued state
cancel prevents late analysis from replacing saved state
failed analysis preserves original and offers retry
normal mainline proposal splits the approved base and bonus before settlement
one confirmation writes coin ledger and exact attribute snapshot
all 13 dimensions and the fixed-scale radar are present

explicit same-fact linking preserves both originals without duplicate coins or attributes

handbook searches original text and limits results

life checklist can be hidden and restored

custom weekly plan appears on selected Monday

missed plan confirmation remains inside card
confirmed missed plan is locked with no event created
plan timer shares the existing settled fact instead of issuing another reward

ending entertainment consumes actual allowance and respects punctuality award

reload preserves second voucher identity and its own elapsed time

new reward never asks the user to decide initial coin price
AI price proposal waits for explicit acceptance
returning to modify reward preserves duration and name
accepted proposal becomes an ordinary redeemable product

saving model is distinct from validation

my page shows the actually saved provider and model

turning off AI does not stop original saving
configuration help contains official links and complete steps

diary keeps question and answer separate and can continue to a new relevant topic
unfinished diary review restores exact question and paired earlier answer
finish stores analysis while keeping original and questions independent

period review saves its sources without creating another diary or event
JSON export includes records, gameplay, 13 attributes, and exact paired diary prompts
download flow left app state unchanged
readable export format is generated: markdown
readable export format is generated: html
readable export format is generated: csv
password confirmation validates equality without storing password
other-device logout is a confirmed account action
email changes only after mock verification step
registration needs no invitation and updates management user inventory

unconfigured new account can start neutral without fabricated AI scores
AI-off reward request keeps draft instead of creating a priced item
returning to the original account restores its own model, records and money
returning user does not see another account private feedback
forgot password uses uniform acknowledgement and does not ask for old password
full questionnaire saves answered and skipped states independently
long-term buying power preference is shown from questionnaire without daily editing field
return update keeps previous funds and baseline
feedback is escaped and privately scoped
management has its own navigation and user statistics
admin search filters actual sample account list
disabling account requires an explicit reason

notice preview does not publish yet
publication changes notice version and management audit
registration switch is saved in site settings
management account security returns to its previous admin page
published notice appears in ordinary home with same state
ordinary user sees the admin response without management controls
disabled registration is reflected in the registration flow
ordinary user cannot enter admin routes through direct hash routing
attribute visibility hides display without changing stored accumulation

progress advice is optional and does not automatically change plans or coins
challenge acceptance locks contract and charges deposit exactly once
